name: Time Travel Tea: Two Witches' Magical Brew
source:
In a quaint magical teashop, lesbian witches Aria and Luna discover a time-traveling tea. Their accidental brew catapults them through history, landing in pivotal moments of tea's rich past. From ancient China to colonial Boston, their journey unfolds like leaves in hot water!

Returning to their magical teashop, changed by their adventures, Aria and Luna face the most important choice - pursue a romantic relationship or remain friends? Their decision, like the perfect cup of tea, steeps in the rich experiences of their journey through time...

[From [url=https://hasalynxgames.itch.io/time-travel-tea-two-witches-magical-brew-lesbian-romance-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
